invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Option<HoodieIndexPlan>, thus result should not be null.
The method delegates directly to an executor using the input parameters, so partitionsToIndex must be non-null.
partitionPaths is passed through from the parameters to the called executor; likely non-null.
indexInstantTime is an identifier for indexing and is very likely required to be a valid, non-empty string.
context is always expected to be provided for engine operations, and the method does not guard against null.
